text:
alicia: Heads-up — planning a base-image rebuild next Wed 02:00 UTC to pick up CVE-2025-4112 patches. Need RBAC for image-signer service account and confirmation KMS rotation won't break existing signed manifest verification. Who owns signer role and audit retention?
ben: I can own signer role changes. Need exact perms: storage.objects.get/list, storage.objects.getIamPolicy? cosign uses access to read/write objects + kms.sign for key signing. Also do we need kms.getPublicKey?
alicia: perms list I'm thinking: roles/storage.objectAdmin on build-bucket, roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on key ring. Tara confirm compliance retention for logs (14 vs 90 days).
tara: Compliance needs 90d audit logs for prod artifacts. If we drop to 14d for cost we need an approved exception. Keep 90d for now.
carl: Runtime note — when we rebase, we also change glibc minor -> can cause musl-based sidecars to mismatch. Suggest canary hosts in us-west1 then EU. Also seccomp profile may need tweak.
alicia: Good call. We'll canary 5 hosts in us-west1, then 10 eu-west-1. Scheduler: deploy windows 02:00-05:00 UTC, rollback at 03:30 if >5% errors.
ben: On KMS rotation: use a secondary key version and keep previous for verification for 30 days. Steps I propose:
```bash
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=artifact-signer --location=global --keyring=redwood-kr
# update signing service config to new key version
# cosign sign -key gcpkms://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/.../cryptoKeyVersions/2
```
We'll also publish a public key to GCS.
devops-bot: Incident reminder: new image push triggered vulnerability alert (#VULN-1258) — triage required.
alicia: CVE-2025-4112 is high (CVSS 7.8) with active exploit PoC. Patch in base image fixed openssl. Need expedited rebuild.
tara: For the audit trail, record the key version id and signer-runner tag in the release notes. Compliance will require a signed attestation blob stored for 90d.
ben: One question: who can approve the KMS rotation PR? Need someone from security + infra. @tara + @ben? (heh)
alicia: I'll put up PR and tag @tara and @carl. Ben please prep migration-runbook and validation script — checksum/verify & cosign verify step.
ben: Will do. Quick verify snippet:
```bash
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/.../... artifact-bucket/myimg:sha256-abc123
gsutil stat gs://artifact-bucket/attestations/sha256-abc123.att
```
I'll also add probing to canary pipeline.
carl: Also add a runtime assert to check seccomp violations in logs: `journalctl -u runc | grep seccomp` — fail canary if > 5 hits/min.
alicia: Perfect. I'll schedule the rollout doc and send calendar invite. Any objections to 02:00 UTC window?
tara: None. Please include a point of contact for on-call. compliance will monitor logs.
alicia: POC: ben (infra), carl (runtime), tara (compliance). I'll post the PR link shortly. :thumbsup: 
ben: ack. Starting perms PR now.
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline started for canary group-1 at 1777552234.
alicia: Closing loop — small checklist for PR:
- RBAC PR granting signer role to infra-signer-sa
- KMS key version creation + public key publish
- Cosign verification test in pipeline
- 90d audit retention set for artifact logs
- Rollback criteria documented

Thanks team.
